CommunityApplications.Profile: MediaLens is a self-hosted, read-only media library analyzer for Unraid. It scans movie and TV libraries and provides an overview of Dolby Vision profiles and enhancement layers, HDR10+, video and audio codecs, immersive audio formats, library health, and playback-device compatibility. This repository maintains the MediaLens Docker application. For documentation, updates, or support, visit the GitHub repository and open an issue.
